units.title: Legislation application foundation
units.scope: Create thin application profile, feature contracts, canonical PR registry, policy fixtures and consumer validation against the core package.
acceptanceCriteria: Equal voting, public anchoring and flexible creator monetization defaults are executable; no core logic is duplicated.
requiredTests: Consumer profile tests and shared registry validation.

units.title: Civic application shell and engine integration
units.scope: Build bill workspace, read-only public page, editor embedding, proposal drawer, neutral participation language and engine SDK integration.
acceptanceCriteria: Author opens one bill across draft, collaboration and public-input views; exact engine version and API compatibility are visible in build evidence.
requiredTests: Consumer contract, keyboard navigation and authenticated browser tests.

units.title: Jurisdictions and legislative document templates
units.scope: Add federal/state/local profiles, bill titles, enacting clauses, findings, definitions, severability, effective dates, fiscal notes and exhibits.
acceptanceCriteria: Templates choose explicit numbering/reference rules; autogenerated language remains editable and cannot imply official filing.
requiredTests: Jurisdiction fixtures, template migration and PDF/DOCX golden comparisons.

units.title: Constituency and participant trust layers
units.scope: Support verified or unverified participation tiers, resident/constituent cohorts, privacy-preserving eligibility evidence, public pseudonyms and duplicate-person controls.
acceptanceCriteria: Each tally labels its actual electorate; exploratory polls are never represented as representative or official elections.
requiredTests: Identity disclosure, forged verification, duplicate cohort membership and eligibility-expiry tests.

units.title: Verified elected-official accounts and grants
units.scope: Verify federal/state/local office, authorized staff, term/office dates and legislative-purpose grants with configurable document/storage allowances.
acceptanceCriteria: Default grant can be unlimited for legitimate legislative work; any heavy-use conversion is explicit and configurable; departure from office expires access appropriately.
requiredTests: Impersonation, staff revocation, grant expiration, quota changes and private verification evidence tests.

units.title: Public input immutable source workflow
units.scope: Freeze an official source edition and let participants propose, debate and cast advisory ballots; add sponsor responses and disposition reports.
acceptanceCriteria: No vote, admin setting, import or background job changes the source edition; sponsor revisions create a separately identified consultation edition.
requiredTests: All mutation paths, concurrent sponsor changes, immutable-link and export comparison browser tests.

units.title: Public collaboration and amendment adoption
units.scope: Configure verified-person/fixed-floor electorates, deliberation periods, adoption policies, competing amendments and readable decision certificates.
acceptanceCriteria: Public collaboration adopts only eligible exact wording, and shows governance acceptance distinctly from legislative enactment.
requiredTests: Mass-vote races, overlapping amendments, threshold boundaries, challenge/revote and actual adoption journey tests.

units.title: Research contributions and academic workspaces
units.scope: Add evidence libraries, citation provenance, professor/class/project groups, thesis-length attachments and concise point summaries without extra civic voting weight.
acceptanceCriteria: Academic affiliation has disclosed provenance and can aid discovery; it never silently increases ballot power.
requiredTests: Role equality, evidence ACL, malicious attachment, attribution and large research navigation tests.

units.title: Civic discussion, moderation and accessibility
units.scope: Tailor concise pro/con debates, conflict-of-interest disclosures, contributor reputation, language access and plain-language explanations.
acceptanceCriteria: Strongest pro and con arguments stay discoverable; paid plans and sponsorship do not boost votes or argument rankings.
requiredTests: Brigading, paid-amplification denial, novice walkthrough, keyboard, screen-reader and multi-language flows.

units.title: Flexible legislation monetization
units.scope: Expose subscriptions, per-document purchases, credits, candidate free weekly creation allowance, sponsored offices and admin overrides through shared entitlement APIs.
acceptanceCriteria: Prices and allowances are data; readers/discussants/voters need no creator subscription; official grants and caps can change without a deployment.
requiredTests: Payment sandbox, quota concurrency, partial refund, free-week timing and grant-to-paid consent tests.

units.title: Public bill histories and independent verification
units.scope: Expose redlines, adopted/rejected proposal histories, public anchor receipts, contributor attribution and downloadable verification packages.
acceptanceCriteria: Any public edition is reproducible and verifiable, with pending anchoring and challenges honestly labeled.
requiredTests: Edited manifest, missing receipt, reorg, public PII and historical export tests.

units.title: Support signatures and sponsor handoff packages
units.scope: Collect opt-in bill-support signatures, readable scalable appendices, constituent summaries and legislative exports; separate support from legal execution.
acceptanceCriteria: Every supporter receipt binds a fixed edition; no PDF signature or platform vote claims to introduce, pass or enact a bill.
requiredTests: Million-record streaming fixture, consent revocation display, private names, frozen edition and sponsor export tests.

units.title: Administration, walkthrough and civic analytics
units.scope: Expose civic parameters in unified admin, elected-official grants, moderation, creator billing, participation dashboards and tailored anchored tours.
acceptanceCriteria: Analytics label turnout denominator and verification coverage; admin changes do not rewrite ongoing ballots or source editions.
requiredTests: Role matrix, tour keyboard/mobile flows, analytics reconciliation and audit tests.

units.title: Civic production release and operations
units.scope: Deploy isolated legislation frontend/configuration on approved infrastructure, run genuine public/private multiuser journeys and publish source-bound evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Real users can create, deliberate, vote, adopt or provide immutable input, sign, export and independently verify within tested capacity.
requiredTests: Current-head full CI, live smoke, accessibility, abuse/load and backup/restore evidence; human review package after deployment.
